about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Sophomore at Southwest Minzu University, majoring in Network & New Media. Passionate about the intersection of content creation and AI technology.
about.bio2: I believe AI is not a replacement for creators, but an amplifier of creative energy. From Prompt Engineering to AI-assisted development, I continuously explore how LLMs can become the accelerator for content production.
about.bio3: Beyond academics, I'm a bilingual anchor, volleyball athlete, and photography enthusiast. These diverse identities give me a richer perspective in content creation.

daka.title: SWUN Campus Automation Tool
daka.description: An automated daily check-in system for Southwest Minzu University, built end-to-end from requirements analysis to deployment. Uses Playwright browser automation with GitHub Actions cron scheduling, adapting to campus network environment and CAS OAuth2.0 authentication for reliable unattended daily operation. Through 18 version iterations, solved challenges including CAS OAuth2.0 protocol adaptation, Vue.js SPA page parsing, and server-side time-window validation.
